Method of Attack: Encrypts mapped network drives and unmapped network shares
Deletes all shadow volume copies using vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet
Creates ransom notes (info.hta and Files encrypted!!.txt)
Configures autorun to start on Windows login to encrypt new files
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with Remote Desktop Services
Attack Vector: Hacking into Remote Desktop Services and manual installation
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes: info.hta and Files encrypted!!.txt
Command to delete shadow copies: vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet
